summary: Neighborhood Intelligence, Inc. (formerly Beyond, Inc.) filed an 8-K disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary Beyond Home Services, LLC and seller F9 Investments, LLC mutually agreed on September 7, 2026 to terminate the July 23, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger under which the company would have acquired F9 Brands, Inc. The seller determined it could not satisfy certain closing conditions, and neither party foresaw satisfaction; the merger agreement permits termination by mutual written consent, rendering it void with no further obligations. No termination fee or price was disclosed. Watch for any fee dispute or renewed bid.
